sources.title: Sonorous Deepslate in Minecraft: Location & Note Mode
sources.author: minecraftthesift.com

facts.label: Find the bases
facts.text: Eight blocks sit in front of the Reinforced Deepslate frame at an Ancient City center.

facts.label: Awaken the setup
facts.text: A Goat Horn played at the Ancient City center brings out a Singer. Its song awakens the bases.

facts.label: Prepare the instruments
facts.text: Place Note Blocks above the awakened Sonorous Deepslate bases.

facts.label: Use Note mode
facts.text: In Note mode, the supporting block lets the Note Block above it use eight Sift notes.

facts.label: Tune and play
facts.text: Right-click the Note Block to change its note; left-click the Note Block to play it.

facts.label: Recognize the completed performance
facts.text: After a correct performance, the bases replay the melody, beams activate, and the portal begins opening.

facts.label: Check your release
facts.text: The author points players to the mod's advancements for explanations of its mechanics.

facts.label: Match the project
facts.text: These block mechanics belong to Mielon's The Sift, whose author listing covers Minecraft Java Edition.

questions.question: Can I get Sonorous Deepslate with a command?
questions.answer: The checked author instructions don't provide an item ID or /give command. For the portal, use the Ancient City setup; for a separate build, check your installed release's block information.

questions.question: Is Sonorous Deepslate available on Bedrock?
questions.answer: Mielon's author listing covers Java Edition and lists no Bedrock release. That scope applies to this project.

questions.question: Which mod adds Sonorous Deepslate?
questions.answer: Mielon's The Sift. The block isn't part of vanilla Minecraft.
